'''''Woebegone''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Ellin Lah]] often traded goods on [[Carlix's Folly]], [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]], [[Sikkem IV]], and [[Vestral]]. It was stolen by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] to escape [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] after an illegal [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] mining operation resulted in the death of [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. The crew of the ship was killed when Plagueis attacked them for trying to check his identification with the authorities. He stole the ship's [[11-4D/Legends|medical droid]] before having the ship sealed and slagged when he docked at [[Deep Space Demolition and Removal]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
